name: Believe
overview: Scripture teaches that belief is foundational to the Christian life, enabling believers to receive from God and experience His power in prayer, as Jesus promises that all things asked in faith will be granted. Jesus encourages unwavering trust, commanding, 'Be not afraid, only believe,' and affirming that all things are possible to those who believe. Even in moments of doubt, faith is expressed as a heartfelt plea for help in unbelief, showing the ongoing struggle and reliance on God's grace. Central to this topic is the promise of eternal life through belief in Christ, as God's love is demonstrated by giving His Son so that whoever believes in Him will not perish but have everlasting life.
